summary: User requested survival-oriented mobile phone shortlist. Compared verified official specifications: Oukitel WP35/WP35 Pro (11,000mAh, 360g), Samsung Galaxy XCover7 Pro (replaceable battery, IP68), Ulefone Armor 34 Pro+ (25,500mAh, lantern), Oukitel WP100 Titan (33,000mAh, 876.6g). Important region caveat: iPhone Emergency SOS via satellite is not supported in Vietnam per Apple; Garmin flags Vietnam as possibly regulated/restricted for inReach. User budget and use scenario not yet provided.
